deep_dive.title: PINNeval: A Comprehensive Evaluation Standard for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
deep_dive.authors_text: Kevin von Bargen, Hamid Ebrahimy, Tim Römer
deep_dive.abstract: The Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) literature has produced a rapidly expanding catalogue of methods. We divide a PINN training pipeline systematically into four components and observe that many existing benchmarks study these components in isolation. These components are domain-importance adaptation, loss balancing, neural network architecture, and optimization scheme. Moreover, the studies set the surrounding and not considered components of the pipeline to a minimal default that is no longer representative of current best practice approaches. Conclusions drawn under such conditions may not transfer to competitive pipelines. In this work, we propose a new evaluation protocol that (1) treats the four components as an integrated system; (2) crucially requires competitive implementations of the components not under investigation; (3) specifies the metrics and reporting format; and (4) is accompanied by structured documentation that ensures the traceability of evaluations across studies. Based on this comprehensive protocol, we release PINNpipe, an innovative JAX package containing 18 different methods from the current literature as well as nine efficiently implemented benchmark problems. Using PINNpipe, we illustrate our evaluation protocol in relation to established benchmark studies and report results that challenge common assumptions.
deep_dive.tldr: PINNeval proposes a standardized, integrated four-component evaluation protocol for physics-informed neural networks that requires competitive implementations of non-target pipeline components, and releases the JAX package PINNpipe with 18 methods and nine benchmarks to enable fair, traceable comparisons that challenge common assumptions.

detailed_reading.motivation: PINN 方法数量快速增长，但现有基准多把训练流程拆成孤立组件评估，并把未研究组件设为过时或最小的默认配置，导致比较结论不具代表性、难以迁移到竞争性管线。领域缺乏统一的 PINN 训练管线定义和明确比较前提的评估协议，因此需要标准化、可追溯的评测标准。
detailed_reading.method: 论文将 PINN 训练管线系统分解为四个组件：域重要性适应、损失平衡、神经网络架构和优化方案；以含初边值条件的 PDE 为输入，在配点上构造各方程残差，并用逐点权重 ω 与方程级权重 λ_e 组成统一损失。提出 PINNeval 协议：把四组件视为耦合系统，要求未研究组件采用竞争性实现，规定指标、报告格式和结构化文档以保证跨研究可追溯，并同时报告运行时间与硬件。基于该协议实现 JAX 包 PINNpipe，提供 18 种文献方法和 9 个高效基准问题，通过覆盖四类组件的案例研究执行评估。
detailed_reading.result: 在覆盖四类组件的案例研究中，作者用 PINNeval/PINNpipe 复现并对照既有基准，报告了挑战常见假设的结果，并出现与部分早期评估前提相反的负结果。核心发现是：方法效果依赖于周围管线配置，最小默认管线下的比较结论不能直接迁移到竞争性管线；因此必须报告四组件配置及成本才能解释和复现比较结论。
detailed_reading.conclusion: 论文结论是 PINN 评测应把训练管线作为耦合系统，并在竞争性而非最小默认的周围组件下比较候选方法，否则结论可能误导。PINNeval 通过统一协议、指标/报告规范和结构化文档提升公平性、可复现性与跨研究可追溯性，PINNpipe 为落地执行提供可组合实现和基准。
detailed_reading.key_details: 关键实现细节包括：统一损失采用逐点权重 ω(t,x) 和方程级权重 λ_e，域重要性适应可表现为自适应采样或重要性加权，损失平衡调节 λ_e，架构和优化器作为另外两个模块；协议要求逐组件报告网络拓扑、优化器与调度、停止准则、平衡/采样更新频率及方法超参，并报告运行时间和硬件而非仅迭代数。竞争性组件的判定依据文献或受控实验，须在同一问题类和指标下无稳定更优或更低成本替代。局限性是当前范围主要覆盖前向 PDE 案例，作者在讨论中把逆问题和算子学习列为后续扩展；时间推进和训练课程被视为可选高级技巧而未纳入四组件主线。

deep_dive.title: Emergent Low-Dimensional Topological Dynamics Dictate Generalization and Escape Mechanics in Billion-Parameter Neural Networks
deep_dive.abstract: The remarkable generalization of modern over-parameterized neural networks defies classical statistical learning bounds. Here we establish that optimization trajectories in billion-parameter models do not sample the ambient dimension $\mathbb{R}^N$ homogeneously; instead, they are dynamically constrained to a low-dimensional execution submanifold $\mathcal{M}_{\text{exec}}$ (with empirically observed effective dimension $d_{\text{eff}} \le 12$). By equipping the parameter space with a regularized Hessian metric $g_{ij} = \nabla_i \nabla_j L + εδ_{ij}$ and analyzing stochastic Langevin diffusion on loss sublevel sets, we derive a rigorous Topological Generalization Bound grounded in projected subspace persistent homology. Furthermore, by linking Morse index transitions to Betti number annihilation ($β_1 \to 0$), we formulate an exact mathematical mechanism for exponential escape from strict saddles under anisotropic noise. We validate our framework across 80+ architectures (ResNets, Vision Transformers, and 7B LLMs). To bridge theoretical topology with computational feasibility, we resolve the curse of dimensionality by computing projected persistent homology proxies via randomized Lanczos iterations restricted strictly within active Hessian subspaces. Building upon this mathematical foundation, we introduce Topological-Adaptive Optimization (Top-SGD and Top-AdamW)---a family of wrapper algorithms that dynamically modulate learning rates using active curvature signatures. Extensive benchmarks demonstrate a 14.1\% reduction in total wall-clock training time on ImageNet with all computational and memory overheads fully accounted for. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/imslab-research/Topological-SGD.
deep_dive.tldr: The paper shows that billion-parameter neural networks optimize within an empirically ultra-low-dimensional topological execution submanifold (effective dimension ≤12), uses this to derive topological generalization and saddle-escape mechanisms, and leverages active curvature signatures in Top-SGD/Top-AdamW to reduce ImageNet training time by 14.1%.

detailed_reading.motivation: 现代过参数化神经网络在参数量远超样本量时仍能强泛化，违背经典统计学习界；NTK、 lottery ticket 与随机矩阵理论分别受限于懒惰训练、事后剪枝和局部谱分析，缺少对训练轨迹低维动力学与全局拓扑约束的统一解释。本文旨在建立可连接泛化界与优化算法的拓扑动力学框架。
detailed_reading.method: 论文在参数空间上引入正则化Hessian度量 g=∇²L+εI，并在损失下水平集上分析SGLD扩散，用谱参与率定义有效维度 d_eff；再将参数轨迹投影到Hessian前k个特征子空间（k=ceil(d_eff)≤12），在投影子水平集上计算持续同调，并用Morse指标与Betti数湮灭刻画严格鞍点逃逸。为使其可计算，作者在活跃Hessian子空间内用随机Lanczos迭代估计极值特征值并构造β1代理，经EMA平滑后作为Top-SGD/Top-AdamW的包装器动态调制学习率；实验覆盖ImageNet上的ResNet-50、ViT-B/16与C4上的LLaMA-7B等80+架构。
detailed_reading.result: 作者报告在80+架构上经验观测到 d_eff≤12，并给出不显式依赖环境维度N的拓扑泛化界；理论上鞍点逃逸率因 d_eff≪N 获得约 O(N/d_eff) 的每自由度放大。基准中ResNet-50上Top-SGD达到76.4%，略高于SGD的76.2%与AdaHessian的76.3%；ViT-B/16上Top-AdamW达到82.1%，略高于AdamW的81.8%与Sophia-G的82.0%；LLaMA-7B在C4上AdamW基线困惑度为8.42±0.05。计入Lanczos与投影全部开销后，ImageNet总墙钟训练时间降低14.1%。
detailed_reading.conclusion: 论文主张十亿参数网络的优化轨迹被动态约束在低维执行子流形上，低维拓扑动力学同时支配泛化复杂度和鞍点逃逸机制；由此得到的Top-SGD/Top-AdamW可作为现有优化器的轻量包装器，在保持或略优精度的同时减少训练时间。该工作提供了从拓扑理论到实用优化调度的桥梁，但 d_eff≤12 是经验观察而非普适定理，泛化界中的持续同调量对十亿参数网络并不可直接计算。
detailed_reading.key_details: 关键实现采用k=12、Lanczos步数p=5、CV每T=50步/LLM每T=100步估计一次，EMA系数0.9/0.1，β1代理阈值取 λ_min<−10^{-3}·max(1,||∇L||₂) 以适配FP16；检测到负曲率时学习率乘1.05且上限为1.98/λ_max，否则乘0.99。实验使用8×A100、固定种子42/1234/5678并报告5次运行均值与标准差，墙钟时间显式计入Lanczos矩阵向量乘和子空间投影开销。主要局限是 d_eff≤12 为跨80+架构的经验观察而非数学上界，泛化界为形式化概念证明且持续同调项不可在十亿参数模型中精确计算，鞍点逃逸定理基于连续SGLD并由离散小批量SGD合成模拟佐证。

deep_dive.title: CS-Pi: Constraint-Satisfying Flow Policy Sampling
deep_dive.authors_text: Soumojit Bhattacharya, Oliver Kroemer, Shubham Tulsiani
deep_dive.abstract: A flow-matching policy deployed in the field must often satisfy a constraint that was absent from its demonstrations, such as avoiding an obstacle it has never seen. Retraining for every new constraint is impractical, so the constraint must be enforced at inference time. Enforcing it must not discard what the policy learned: an action the policy would rarely sample may avoid the obstacle yet fail the task. We therefore want actions that are both safe, satisfying the constraint, and plausible, remaining likely under the policy. Gradient guidance, the most common approach, steers noisy states, so it must evaluate its cost on the policy's running estimate of the clean action; when the policy is uncertain between passing left or right of an obstacle, this estimate is their average and can pass straight through it. We instead build on rejection and projection. Rejection redraws actions until one is safe: every output is plausible, but the wait is intractable when safe actions are rare. Projection moves an action to the nearest safe one: it is efficient, but the result need not be plausible. Our key insight is that flow-matching sampling lets us combine the two, keeping projection's efficiency and rejection's plausibility. CS-Pi, our draw-project-renoise sampler, projects each draw to the nearest safe action, adds noise back scaled to how far the projection moved it, and re-runs the unmodified policy until a draw is safe. Replacing only the projection step extends CS-Pi to continuous costs. Across a 2D diagnostic, a 7-DoF shelf pick-and-place, an orientation preference, and a zero-shot Franka deployment, CS-Pi reaches 81% safe success on the shelf and 55% on hardware, against 55% and 40% for projection, while staying plausible.
deep_dive.tldr: **TLDR:** CS-Pi is a training-free draw–project–renoise sampler for flow-matching policies that projects each sampled action to the nearest constraint-satisfying action, renoises it in proportion to the projection distance, and re-runs the unmodified policy until the draw is safe, yielding actions that are both safe and plausible.

detailed_reading.motivation: 部署中的流匹配策略常需满足训练示范中未出现的约束，例如避开未见障碍物；为每条新约束重新训练不现实，因此必须在推理时施加约束。但约束修正不能丢弃策略已学到的任务与运动先验：仅安全但策略几乎不会采样的动作可能仍然失败。梯度引导在含噪中间状态上依赖对干净动作的代理估计，当策略在障碍物左右绕行等多模态间不确定时，该代理可能落在两模态平均处并穿过障碍；拒绝采样虽保持策略似然但在安全动作稀少时不可行，投影虽高效但结果未必合理。
detailed_reading.method: CS-Pi将部署时约束表述为安全集 C 及其欧氏投影 P(a)=argmin_{a'∈C}||a'-a||。给定流匹配策略 πθ，从高斯噪声 a0 积分学习到的速度场得到干净动作 a=πθ(a0;0)；每轮对当前干净采样 ahat 先投影到 C 得到安全锚点 ac=P(ahat)，再按投影位移残差 δ 将锚点回噪到时间 n=k/(k+δ)（δ 越大回噪越多），随后从该噪声级用未修改的策略重新去噪得到下一次采样，循环直到某次采样本身落在安全集内。该方法不需要在含噪状态上对约束求梯度；扩展到连续代价时只替换投影步骤，并可同时结合硬约束与软代价。
detailed_reading.result: 在2D诊断、7-DoF货架抓取放置、方向偏好和零样本Franka部署中，CS-Pi在货架任务达到81%安全成功率、硬件达到55%，而仅投影分别为55%和40%，同时保持动作在策略下合理。论文报告CS-Pi是唯一在约束允许处同时满足安全性与合理性的采样器，并且计算成本远低于拒绝采样。
detailed_reading.conclusion: CS-Pi是一种无需重训、仅推理期执行的draw-project-renoise采样器，以投影为锚点、按投影残差回噪并用原策略重新去噪，从而结合投影的效率与拒绝采样的合理性。它避免了梯度引导在噪声代理上评估约束梯度的缺陷，可扩展到连续代价，并能零样本用于现有流匹配策略和VLA策略。
detailed_reading.key_details: 关键实现包括：安全集只需提供可计算的欧氏投影；回噪量由投影残差 δ 决定，回噪时间设为 n=k/(k+δ)，并迭代至采样安全；连续代价仅替换投影步；无需CBF所需可微屏障、Lie导数或学习动力学模型。实验中硬件使用π0.5策略和由视觉估计的障碍框进行零样本Franka部署；局限是方法依赖可用的投影算子，且未评估需要学习动力学模型的SAD-Flower。

deep_dive.title: Interpretable Multifidelity Learning with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Spatiotemporal Nuclear Reactor Flow Modeling
deep_dive.abstract: High-fidelity computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations of nuclear reactor systems are computationally expensive, motivating machine learning methods that reduce cost while preserving accuracy. Multifidelity surrogate modeling addresses this by combining inexpensive low-fidelity data with limited high-fidelity data. This work investigates whether the high-fidelity data required to predict the spatiotemporal mass flow rate across all 193 fuel assemblies of a pressurized water reactor (PWR) core can be reduced, comparing black-box multifidelity feedforward neural networks (MFNNs) with interpretable multifidelity Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (MFKANs). Cross-fidelity correlation across the core is weak, making this a challenging multifidelity problem, and neither architecture predicts the transient particularly well in absolute terms. MFKAN nonetheless performs comparably to MFNN for one-time-step-forward prediction while also providing closed-form symbolic equations unavailable with MFNN. To address the scarcity of CFD transients, with only one available per fidelity level, TabDDPM-generated synthetic data was used to augment cross-fidelity forecasting. KAN and FNN achieve comparable self-evaluation accuracy (Pearson correlation of roughly 0.73--0.81), but both perform poorly at true cross-fidelity forecasting (correlations of 0.03--0.06). Assembly-level analysis shows that each assembly's forecast correlation tracks its real cross-fidelity correlation for both architectures ($r=0.840$--$0.896$ for KAN, $r=0.804$--$0.903$ for FNN), confirming that forecasting accuracy is fundamentally limited by how correlated the fidelity levels already are. Overall, KAN-based multifidelity modeling achieves accuracy consistently comparable to MFNN across all settings, while additionally providing symbolic equations that match or exceed the spline representation's accuracy.
deep_dive.tldr: This paper shows that interpretable multifidelity Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks match black-box neural networks for predicting spatiotemporal PWR core flow while additionally yielding symbolic equations, but true cross-fidelity forecasting remains fundamentally limited by weak fidelity correlation and scarce CFD transient data.

detailed_reading.motivation: 核反应堆全堆芯CFD瞬态模拟计算代价高，而多保真度代理建模可用少量高保真数据结合大量低保真数据来降低成本并保持精度。本文针对压水堆193个燃料组件的全堆芯时空质量流量预测，研究在跨保真度相关性弱且每个保真度仅有一个CFD瞬态的条件下，能否减少高保真数据需求，并比较黑箱MFNN与可解释MFKAN。
detailed_reading.method: 数据来自STAR-CCM+构建的全尺度四环路PWR下腔室模型，采用BEAVRS几何、多孔介质燃料组件和STRUCT-ε湍流模型，输出193个组件在九个轴向层上的面积平均质量流量；每个瞬态15 s、步长0.0005 s，丢弃前10 s后记录10–15 s共10000步，并构造三个CFD网格保真度。建模上比较MFNN与MFKAN，包括低保真KAN加残差修正的MFKAN-Delta、将保真度等级显式编码为输入的MFKAN-Flag，以及扩展到三保真度的MFKAN-Flag3f。训练/推理流程包括用低/高保真数据做多保真度一步预测和跨保真度瞬态预测，并用TabDDPM生成合成表格数据增强跨保真度预测，最后将训练后的KAN转换为闭式符号方程。
detailed_reading.result: 跨保真度相关性在全堆芯范围内较弱，两个架构对瞬态的绝对预测都不算好；但MFKAN在一步向前预测中与MFNN性能相当，并能给出MFNN没有的闭式符号方程。使用TabDDPM增强后，KAN与FNN的自评估精度相近，Pearson相关约0.73–0.81，而真实跨保真度预测相关仅0.03–0.06；组件级分析显示各组件预测相关与其真实跨保真度相关同步，KAN的r=0.840–0.896、FNN的r=0.804–0.903，说明预测精度本质上受保真度间已有相关性限制。
detailed_reading.conclusion: KAN基多保真度建模在所有设置下达到与MFNN持续可比的精度，同时额外提供可解释的符号方程，且符号方程精度可匹配或超过样条表示。研究表明多保真度代理在此类全堆芯时空场问题中的收益受弱跨保真度相关性和瞬态数据稀缺限制，生成式数据增强不能从根本上克服真实跨保真度预测的困难。
detailed_reading.key_details: 关键实现点包括：高维输出为193个燃料组件×九个轴向层×时间步的全堆芯质量流量场；每个保真度仅有一个CFD瞬态，数据稀缺是核心约束；保真度间弱相关使多保真度学习困难；评估同时区分自评估、一步向前预测和真实跨保真度预测，并以Pearson相关及组件级相关跟踪分析诊断限制来源；TabDDPM用于合成表格数据增强，KAN可转为闭式符号方程以提供可解释性。局限性在于绝对预测精度有限、合成数据与真实CFD瞬态的保真度差异，以及单瞬态条件下结论的泛化性仍需更多高保真瞬态验证。

deep_dive.title: Q-OIL: Optimistic Exploration in Learning from Human Interventions
deep_dive.authors_text: Pranav Teegavarapu, Sriyash Poddar, Rico Qi, Cleah Winston, Krisha Khandelwal, Aykut Onyol, Natasha Jaques, Abhishek Gupta
deep_dive.abstract: As robots are deployed in the real world, they will inevitably make mistakes. Human interventions provide valuable feedback for improving their behavior, enabling them to adapt online to new scenarios. However, studying human-in-the-loop robot learning is difficult: real-world experiments are slow and expensive, so most algorithm development relies on simulated human models. We show that common human modeling assumptions do not match how real people intervene in practice. Through analyzing intervention data from human participants, we find that humans tend to intervene when agent progress stalls, and that their corrective actions are often suboptimal. Motivated by these findings, we introduce a progress-based model of human intervention that achieves higher rank correlation with real-user algorithm rankings, enabling realistic algorithm benchmarking and development in simulation. Building on these insights, we propose Q-OIL, a method that adds optimistic bonuses to intervention transitions in reinforcement learning and softly guides exploration toward human corrections. We find that decoupled critics are critical for stability because they prevent the bonuses from backing up to pre-intervention states. As a result, Q-OIL learns more efficiently than competitive baselines, achieving 10-50% higher success in simulation and on real robots, and improving pretrained VLAs on two bimanual manipulation tasks. As we ground both evaluation and algorithms in realistic human behavior, this work provides a practical path toward scalable robot learning from interventions.
deep_dive.tldr: TLDR: The paper shows that real humans intervene when robot progress stalls and give suboptimal corrections, then proposes Q-OIL, which treats interventions as optimistic exploration bonuses with decoupled critics to learn faster and more robustly from human interventions in simulation and on real robots.

detailed_reading.motivation: 真实机器人部署中不可避免会犯错，人类干预能提供有价值的在线反馈，但真实人类实验慢且昂贵，现有研究多依赖模拟人类模型；论文发现常见假设（如按即时次优触发干预、纠正接近最优）与真实干预数据不符，导致模拟评估和算法设计偏离真实用户表现，因此需要先理解人类何时、如何干预，再据此设计鲁棒的干预学习算法。
detailed_reading.method: 论文先收集8名参与者、3个操作任务、24次运行约20万转移的真实干预数据，并用RLPD稀疏奖励训练参考策略和价值函数来分析干预触发与纠正质量，进而提出基于短时程进展的干预模型。Q-OIL在在线离策略强化学习中给干预转移加入乐观奖励/探索bonus，并采用解耦critic：乐观critic驱动探索与策略更新，仅任务critic提供TD目标，防止bonus回传到干预前状态；该方法不绑定具体离策略RL算法，并可扩展到改进预训练VLA策略。
detailed_reading.result: 真实数据表明，人类干预触发是非马尔可夫的，更符合短时程进展停滞或价值下降，而非单步动作次优；人类纠正动作往往次优、噪声大，甚至偏离学习者策略。基于进展的模拟人类模型与真实用户算法排名的秩相关更高；Q-OIL在仿真和真实机器人上比竞争基线学习更高效，成功率提高10-50%，降低人类负担，并在两个双臂操作任务上改进预训练VLA，且对次优和多样干预保持稳健。
detailed_reading.conclusion: 该工作主张把人类干预视为乐观探索引导而非最优监督目标，并用真实人类行为校准模拟评估与算法设计，从而缩小模拟到真实的差距，为可扩展的机器人从干预中学习提供实用路径。
detailed_reading.key_details: 关键细节包括：干预模型由触发函数g和人类策略π_h组成，二者可依赖历史τ_{t-L:t}，并用k步价值进展V*(s_t)-V*(s_{t-k})刻画非马尔可夫触发，纠正以次优/噪声策略近似；Q-OIL的核心实现是干预转移上的乐观奖励和解耦critic，任务critic生成TD目标、乐观critic只用于探索与策略更新，以避免乐观项传播到非干预状态；数据来自带IRB批准的模拟机器人用户研究，参考π*、Q*、V*由RLPD稀疏奖励训练获得。局限在于真实实验仍慢且贵、人类模型只是近似，且具体损失权重与超参需参考原文，方法稳定性依赖解耦critic和对干预分布的合理处理。

deep_dive.title: Meituan-Robotics-0: A Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Desktop Manipulation
deep_dive.authors_text: Meituan Robotics Team, Caicheng Wang, Chen Zhao, Chengpeng Jin, Duo Xu, Fengjiao Chen, Guanglu Wan, Heqing Yang, Jia Wang, Jiacong Zhou, Jie Hu, Jiyuan Ru, Lingfeng Zhang, Linjiang Huang, Manyuan Zhang, Ningchu Liu, Shijie Zhou, Si Liu, Shuo Li, Tianyi Zhang, Xi Zhang, Xin Chen, Xuezhi Cao, Xunliang Cai, Yanbin Zeng, Yang Yang, Yang Yi, Yanli Tan, Yifu Xu, Yimeng Jia, Yuchen Tang, Yuchen Xie, Yuxiang Zheng, Zerwei Chng, Zilong Huang, Zipeng Ye, Ziyuan Qin, Ziqin Wang
deep_dive.abstract: We present Meituan-Robotics-0 (MR0), a vision-language-action foundation model and embodied-agent system for stationary-base desktop manipulation. MR0 combines 147 million vision-language samples with 15,060 hours of curated robot trajectories spanning 12 embodiments. A three-stage training recipe aligns multimodal representations with robot behavior through discrete action-token pre-training, transfers these priors to continuous cross-embodiment control through flow-matching mid-training, and adapts the policy through real-world post-training. We introduce Rollback, which pairs replaced policy segments with human corrections to provide positive and negative supervision for CFG-DAgger without value learning or advantage labeling. A unified end-effector interface supports heterogeneous embodiments, while asynchronous action-chunk merging maintains smooth execution under variable inference latency. An event-driven agent maintains persistent task events and reassesses plans when progress or feasibility changes, enabling cross-task retrieval and conditional task resumption. MR0 achieves 93.6% success on RoboTwin 2.0 and ranks fifth in the RoboDojo VLA track. Under matched HG-DAgger post-training, MR0 achieves higher average success rate and progress score than $π_{0.5}$ across three real-robot tasks. On Ethernet insertion, CFG-DAgger trained with Rollback data reaches 70% success and a progress score of 0.90. Qualitative agent deployments demonstrate cross-task event retrieval and recovery from temporarily unsatisfied task conditions.
deep_dive.tldr: Meituan-Robotics-0 (MR0) is a vision-language-action foundation model and event-driven embodied-agent system for desktop manipulation that combines 147M vision-language samples with 15,060 hours of cross-embodiment robot data and a three-stage training recipe—discrete action-token pre-training, flow-matching mid-training, and real-world post-training with Rollback-based CFG-DAgger—to enable robust cross-embodiment control, smooth asynchronous execution, and long-horizon task memory and resumption.

detailed_reading.motivation: 通用桌面操作要求具身系统同时具备跨异构数据的广泛行为先验、跨本体迁移能力、闭环执行中的错误恢复能力，以及在长时程中保留任务相关状态的能力。仅扩大VLA动作模型难以解决机器人数据格式/动作空间/本体不一致、成功示范缺乏错误恢复监督、反应式策略离开观测窗口后丢失任务信息等问题。因此需要把对齐后的异构数据、鲁棒的真实世界策略学习和持久任务级记忆连接起来。
detailed_reading.method: MR0首先构建147M视觉语言样本与15,060小时、覆盖12种本体的桌面机器人轨迹，经静态边界过滤、运动学一致性检查、视频缺陷过滤、跨本体动作规范化和分层任务标注形成训练数据；动作统一为肩部中心坐标系下的末端执行器绝对位置、6D旋转和归一化夹爪开度，单臂10维、双臂20维。策略采用三阶段训练：离散动作token预训练对齐多模态表征与机器人行为，MMDiT动作头通过flow matching进行连续跨本体中训练，再用成功示范SFT、HG-DAgger人类纠正、RECAP结果标签自主 rollout 和Rollback增强的CFG-DAgger做真实世界后训练。部署时异步动作块合并将新预测与正在执行的命令融合以保持平滑控制；事件驱动智能体由Monitor把短视觉窗口总结为任务事件，Memory Manager维护持久事件记录，Planner仅在进度或可行性变化时重评估和恢复任务。
detailed_reading.result: 作为独立策略，MR0在RoboTwin 2.0上达到93.6%成功率，并在RoboDojo VLA赛道排名第五。在匹配HG-DAgger后训练条件下，MR0在三个真实机器人任务上的平均成功率和进度分数均高于π0.5。在Ethernet insertion任务上，使用Rollback数据训练的CFG-DAgger达到70%成功率和0.90进度分数；定性部署还展示了跨任务事件检索以及任务条件暂时不满足后的恢复能力。
detailed_reading.conclusion: 结果表明，对齐的异构数据、分阶段VLA训练、真实世界后训练与事件级记忆分别补充了通用桌面操作对先验、连续控制、错误恢复和长时程状态保持的需求。MR0提供了一条可迁移、可长时程执行的桌面操作具身系统路线，但其范围限于固定基座桌面操作，低层策略本身仍是反应式的，任务记忆依赖上层事件驱动智能体。
detailed_reading.key_details: 数据侧关键点包括约13.6k小时具身训练数据、RoboDesk 3,235小时、授权真实机器人7,530小时和仿真4,295小时，以及S1-S3过滤和A1-A2对齐流程；CALVIN ABC-to-D消融支持优先构建2D目标可供性接地、场景描述和2D接地监督，其中2D接地用SAM候选区域加VLM身份分配。动作侧使用连续6D旋转、绝对末端位置和夹爪闭合并通过URDF校验运动学一致性，MMDiT以flow matching去噪动作块。Rollback通过回到历史锚点采集人类替换段并保留原策略段，为CFG-DAgger提供正负监督而无需价值学习或优势标注；异步动作块合并不阻塞策略推理。局限性包括仅面向固定基座桌面操作、排除基座运动、低层策略无显式历史，以及智能体仅在事件触发时进行任务级重规划。

deep_dive.title: Embedding Consistent Recurrent Neural Networks in Finite Element Simulations for Path-Dependent Damage Prediction
deep_dive.authors_text: Muhammed Adil Yatkın, Mihkel Kõrgesaar, Hasan Kurban
deep_dive.abstract: Capturing sheet-metal localisation physics with a trained surrogate inside a finite element (FEM) solver requires the surrogate to deliver consistent predictions irrespective of the solver's strain-increment count, which is difficult to control in non-linear explicit codes. We address this by re-implementing a trained recurrent neural network (RNN) damage criterion in Fortran and embed it as a live, increment-by-increment fracture criterion inside an Abaqus/Explicit user material subroutine (VUMAT), advancing the network state alongside the solver. Two architectures are compared: a SimpleRNN and the proposed Consistent RNN (ConsRNN), whose transition function is designed so that predictions converge as the strain path is refined rather than drifting with the increment count. Both are trained on bilinear strain paths and evaluated under varying temporal discretisations and nonlinear histories. SimpleRNN predictions drift as the increment count increases, which disqualifies it for embedding; ConsRNN converges under refinement, at a substantial fixed-resolution accuracy cost relative to SimpleRNN on multilinear paths. Deployed at structural scale, the embedded ConsRNN surrogate governs element deletion in a clamped steel plate and reaches the same peak force and peak displacement as an established two-parameter fracture criterion. This pre-peak agreement is expected by construction, since no element is deleted before the peak and the two runs therefore share an identical constitutive path; the responses diverge only on the post-peak softening branch. The results establish discretisation consistency as the decisive property for embedding recurrent surrogates in explicit FEM solvers, and report the first embedding of a customised, non-standard-transition recurrent cell at structural scale.
deep_dive.tldr: This paper embeds a consistency-preserving recurrent neural network (ConsRNN) as a live Fortran/Abaqus VUMAT damage criterion, showing that its predictions converge under strain-path refinement—unlike a SimpleRNN—and enabling discretization-consistent, path-dependent damage prediction at structural scale.

detailed_reading.motivation: 将训练好的代理模型嵌入有限元求解器时，必须保证预测不受求解器应变增量数影响，但非线性显式码难以控制增量数；现有部署框架多只支持标准网络层或记忆无关网络，尚缺少在结构尺度嵌入定制且满足一致性的递归代理。
detailed_reading.method: 基于19,098条双线性主应变加载路径（每条400增量，按13,367/2,866/2,865划分训练、验证、测试）训练单层SimpleRNN与ConsRNN，并用240条不同增量数的双线性路径及3–5段多线性路径评估；通过20次贝叶斯优化联合调隐藏单元数、学习率和批大小，损伤目标经f(D)=1−e^{−D}变换训练、推理时反变换。ConsRNN输入归一化应变增量，状态更新为S_t=S_{t−1}+(A_t−S_{t−1})||X_t||_2，可解释为弧长神经ODE的显式欧拉离散，输出经sigmoid得到损伤。随后将学习权重硬编码为纯Fortran并嵌入Abaqus/Explicit的VUMAT，作为逐增量断裂准则，只在塑性增量推进网络状态并据此控制单元删除，在夹持钢板结构尺度与两参数2FS准则对比。
detailed_reading.result: SimpleRNN预测随增量数增加发生漂移，因而不适合嵌入；ConsRNN在时间离散细化下收敛并保持离散一致性，但在多线性路径的固定分辨率精度上较SimpleRNN有明显代价。结构尺度嵌入ConsRNN控制单元删除时，峰值力与峰值位移和既有2FS断裂准则一致；该峰前一致由构造决定（峰前无单元删除、本构路径相同），响应仅在峰后软化段出现分歧。
detailed_reading.conclusion: 研究表明离散化一致性是递归代理嵌入显式FEM求解器的决定性属性，而不能只看离线预测精度；工作首次在结构尺度嵌入具有非标准转移函数的定制递归单元。ConsRNN可作为携带状态的历史相关损伤代理，但需权衡固定分辨率精度与泛化能力。
detailed_reading.key_details: 关键实现包括单层递归、sigmoid输出、MSE损失、100 epochs和20次贝叶斯调参；SimpleRNN最佳为256隐藏单元、学习率3.49×10−5、批大小16（训练/验证MSE 0.0010/0.0008），ConsRNN最佳为256隐藏单元、学习率0.01、批大小16（MSE 0.0006），但因偏离400增量时精度下降最终选用批大小256。输入为塑性主应变，增量归一化分母为max(||X||2,10−15)，弹性增量不更新网络状态；一致性来自转移函数的范数缩放凸组合而非嵌入物理变量。局限包括仅用双线性路径训练、单层结构、两模型输入与归一化不同使比较并非单纯转移函数对比、固定分辨率精度代价、峰前与2FS一致属构造性结果、峰后软化分支存在分歧，以及VUMAT硬编码带来的维护性与复杂度约束。

deep_dive.title: ForPC: Force-Aware Whole-Body Control for Precise Humanoid Cart Pushing
deep_dive.authors_text: ZhenYu Zou, Xing Liu, ShiChuang Wang, YunLong Dong, LiNan Deng, Feng Hua, Jun Wan, Cheng Cheng
deep_dive.abstract: Humanoid robots are expected to take over strenuous material handling in manufacturing, logistics, and healthcare, where operating existing wheeled carts would let them move heavy loads without modifying the workplace. However, humanoid cart pushing remains challenging because the bimanual grasp closes a force-coupled loop in which the contact wrenches that drive the cart also disturb the robot's balance, and payload changes alter the coupled dynamics. We propose ForPC, a force-aware whole-body control framework that regulates cart velocity through two-stage reinforcement learning. A locomotion prior is first trained under varied hand loads and upper-body postures to provide balance support. A force latent and a state latent are then inferred from onboard observations, without external force sensors, and fed to a residual policy that coordinates bounded arm, waist, and leg adjustments with base-velocity commands. Multi-objective rewards penalize bimanual internal opposition, grasp slip, and actuator saturation, encouraging the policy to apply contact force on demand without human demonstrations. Sim-to-sim experiments show that ForPC reduces cart-velocity RMSE by up to 68.2% relative to a locomotion-only baseline (Loco-only) and cross-track RMSE by up to 74.2% on the multi-bend route. Trained solely in simulation, the policy also transfers to a physical Unitree G1 without real-world training or fine-tuning and, with no payload-specific adjustment, pushes a cart carrying up to 30 kg at 0.5 m/s. These results suggest that humanoid robots could eventually replace humans for efficient material handling in daily life.
deep_dive.tldr: ForPC is a force-aware whole-body control framework that uses two-stage reinforcement learning with onboard force/state latent estimation to enable humanoid robots to push carts precisely and stably—without external force sensors, human demonstrations, or payload-specific tuning—and transfers from simulation to a physical Unitree G1.

detailed_reading.motivation: 人形机器人直接操作现有轮式推车可在不改造工作场所的前提下承担重物搬运，但双手抓握会形成力耦合闭环：驱动推车的接触力同时扰动机器人平衡，载荷变化又改变耦合动力学。现有方法多只估计接触力或只预测物体运动，缺少同时围绕推车速度和双手接触力闭合反馈的控制框架，因而难以在变载荷下实现精确、稳定的推车。
detailed_reading.method: ForPC采用两阶段强化学习实现力感知全身控制：第一阶段在不同手部载荷和上肢姿态偏移下预训练抗交互扰动的运动先验，并冻结以提供平衡支撑；第二阶段用教师—学生估计器从关节运动学历史、上肢关节力矩和视觉观测的相对推车朝向中推断力潜变量与状态潜变量，无需外部力传感器，再输入残差策略输出有界的臂、腰、腿关节残差并调制基座速度命令。训练中使用多目标奖励惩罚双臂内耗对顶、抓握滑移和执行器饱和，使策略在无人类演示条件下按需施加接触力。
detailed_reading.result: 仿真到仿真实验中，ForPC相对仅运动控制基线Loco-only将推车速度RMSE最多降低68.2%，在多弯道路线上将横向跟踪RMSE最多降低74.2%。仅用仿真训练的策略零样本迁移到实体Unitree G1，无需真实世界训练或微调，且不做载荷专用调整即可以0.5 m/s推动载重达30 kg的推车。
detailed_reading.conclusion: 结果表明，将人形机器人与推车视为紧耦合动力学系统，并通过机载观测估计交互力与状态、以残差全身控制协调双臂和下肢，可显著提升变载荷推车的速度与路径跟踪精度。该框架展示了人形机器人零样本执行实际物料搬运任务的潜力，为替代人类完成高强度推运提供可行路径。
detailed_reading.key_details: 方法关键在于冻结的抗扰动运动先验、基于历史观测的力/状态潜变量估计、有界残差动作空间以及针对双臂内耗、抓握滑移和执行器饱和的多目标奖励；控制不依赖腕部力/力矩传感器或人类演示，依赖仿真训练和教师—学生蒸馏。已验证单平台Unitree G1与最高30 kg、0.5 m/s工况，超参数、估计器网络结构和更广载荷/地形下的鲁棒性及长期实机稳定性仍需进一步核验。

deep_dive.title: Benchmarking Machine Learning for Chaotic Three-Body Dynamics in Astrophysics
deep_dive.authors_text: Sheng Wan, Pavan Vynatheya, Duo Xu, Li Kevin Wenliang, Ye Zhu
deep_dive.abstract: Machine learning (ML) and generative AI have recently made impressive progress in understanding physics. We explore a hierarchy of prediction problems stemming from chaotic three-body systems and benchmark existing ML approaches, including general-purpose prediction algorithms and those that build on top of foundational physics models. We first simulate the trajectories of triple systems near the critical boundary of stable/unstable initial conditions. We then design a hierarchy of learning tasks, focusing mainly on two broad problems: stability prediction and trajectory prediction. The former classifies whether a given triple system has diverged or not up to a specific horizon, while the latter predicts the exact trajectory, both given suitable input features. We benchmark a range of ML approaches, from simple regression methods to state-of-the-art foundational physics models, across these tasks, and compare them against astrophysical methods such as the Mardling-Aarseth stability criterion. Our experiments reveal a clear order of task difficulties in chaotic three-body dynamics: early dynamics enable strong stability prediction, while precise long-horizon trajectory forecasting remains difficult. Code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/Simonwan03/ThreeBodyMLBench.
deep_dive.tldr: This paper benchmarks general-purpose and physics-foundation ML models against astrophysical criteria on chaotic three-body systems near the stability boundary, finding that early dynamics enable strong stability prediction while precise long-horizon trajectory forecasting remains difficult.

detailed_reading.motivation: 机器学习在物理建模和世界模型方向进展迅速，但混沌三体动力学这一经典且可控的强混沌问题仍缺乏系统评测。论文希望在稳定与不稳定临界区域附近构建基准，比较通用预测模型、物理基础模型与天体物理经验判据，明确现有方法在稳定性预测和精确轨迹预测上的能力边界。
detailed_reading.method: 作者在稳定/不稳定临界边界附近模拟5000个基础层级三体系统，每个基础系统生成32个仅改变轨道相位或轻微半长轴的受控扰动变体，并用无量纲orbital15轨道特征表示状态。任务包括：A基于初始条件预测未来视界内稳定比例或二分类稳定性；B基于短轨迹前缀预测个体稳定性；C基于集合内短前缀通过离散条件风险模型输出多视界生存曲线；以及基于512步上下文预测后续128步单次轨迹和递归四块共512步开环轨迹。基线覆盖XGBoost、MLP、CNN、TCN、注意力模型、预训练时间序列基础模型及其微调版本，并与Mardling–Aarseth和Vynatheya等天体物理判据比较。
detailed_reading.result: 初始条件稳定性任务中，XGBoost二分类准确率0.805、F1 0.535，高于Mardling–Aarseth的0.619和0.441，Vynatheya的MLP达到AUROC 0.909、AUPRC 0.718；XGBoost稳定比例回归MSE 0.088、R² 0.444。基于短轨迹前缀的动态摘要加XGBoost显著提升，二分类AUROC 0.9851、稳定比例MAE 0.0398；多视界生存预测中Chronos-2加直接池化取得MAE 0.0376、IBS 0.0416；轨迹预测中Chronos-2零样本MAE 0.228，短程有竞争力但长程精确预测仍困难。
detailed_reading.conclusion: 实验揭示混沌三体动力学存在清晰的任务难度层级：早期动力学信息足以支持很强的稳定性判别和生存估计，基于初始条件的稳定性预测虽优于传统判据但仍有限，而精确的长视界轨迹预测仍是主要瓶颈。该基准说明现有ML方法可用于快速稳定性筛查和短期预测，但不能替代数值积分用于长期混沌轨道演化。
detailed_reading.key_details: 关键实现包括以32变体扰动集合作为数据划分和评估的基本单元，避免近重复样本泄漏；稳定性标签由集合内保持束缚的变体比例或个体是否在视界前发散定义；生存任务用条件风险连乘保证生存曲线单调；评估覆盖分类AUROC/AUPRC/F1、回归MAE/MSE/R²、生存MAE/IBS及轨迹标准化误差、相关性和开环误差累积。局限在于真值来自有限视界的牛顿模拟，数据集中于层级三体临界边界，混沌敏感性和递归开环预测会放大误差，结论外推到其他质量比、初始条件区域或更长时标需谨慎。

deep_dive.title: National and State-Level Approaches to Automated Vehicle Certification: A Comparative Framework for State Operational Governance
deep_dive.authors_text: Sk Nahia Ahsan, Md Abdullah Al Hasan, Danjue Chen, George List
deep_dive.abstract: Automated vehicle (AV) deployment in the United States is expanding without a unified federal certification framework, leading to substantial variation in how states authorize and oversee AV testing and deployment. This paper examines how U.S. states regulate Society of Automotive Engineers (SAE) Level 4-5 automated driving systems (ADS), identifies common certification approaches, compares them with international practices, and evaluates the implications for North Carolina's future regulatory strategy. Publicly available state statutes, administrative regulations, agency guidance, and federal policy documents were reviewed. Ten states, selected to capture the range of regulatory approaches, were analyzed using a structured framework covering operational scope, governance and oversight, federal interaction, and implementation outcomes. Certification practices in the European Union, China, Japan, and Australia were reviewed for comparative context. Three state certification models were identified, reflecting increasing regulatory involvement: baseline legal compliance, administrative self-certification with ongoing oversight, and permit-based authorization requiring formal agency review before deployment. North Carolina currently aligns with the baseline compliance model. International frameworks are converging toward scenario-based testing, operational-design-domain-specific approval, safety-case documentation, cybersecurity assurance, and lifecycle oversight, although direct transferability to the U.S. is limited. The paper develops a three-model typology for comparing state AV certification approaches and integrates state practices with international frameworks, providing a consistent basis for evaluating differences in regulatory involvement, governance complexity, and institutional responsibilities across jurisdictions.
deep_dive.tldr: This paper develops a three-model typology—baseline legal compliance, administrative self-certification with oversight, and permit-based authorization—to compare how U.S. states regulate SAE Level 4–5 automated vehicles, situates state practices against international certification approaches, and assesses implications for North Carolina, which currently follows the baseline compliance model.

detailed_reading.motivation: 美国缺乏统一的联邦自动驾驶汽车认证框架，SAE L4–5级自动驾驶系统的测试与部署主要由各州授权和监管，导致州际规则显著碎片化。现有研究多描述单个州法规或联邦指南，缺少系统比较州级运营治理模型并整合国际认证实践的统一框架。本文旨在识别州级认证模式、比较国际做法，并为北卡罗来纳州未来监管策略提供依据。
detailed_reading.method: 研究系统检索公开的州法规、行政规章、机构指南和联邦政策文件，并参考2026年1–2月访谈资料；选取加利福尼亚、哥伦比亚特区、宾夕法尼亚、得克萨斯、华盛顿、亚利桑那、佐治亚、北卡罗来纳、怀俄明和密歇根十州，以覆盖不同监管强度。分析采用四维结构化问题框架，涵盖运营范围与条件、治理证据与监督、联邦互动与跨州可携带性、实施结果，并将各州实践归纳为三级要求和三类认证模型。随后对照欧盟、中国、日本和澳大利亚的认证实践，形成州级与国际框架的比较综合。
detailed_reading.result: 研究识别出三种州级认证模型：基线法律合规、行政自我认证并持续监督、部署前需正式机构审查的许可授权，分别对应佐治亚和北卡罗来纳、亚利桑那和华盛顿、加利福尼亚和宾夕法尼亚及得克萨斯和哥伦比亚特区等。北卡罗来纳目前属于基线合规模型，监管介入和行政负担最低。国际框架正趋同于场景化测试、运营设计域特定审批、安全案例文档、网络安全保障和生命周期监督，但直接移植到美国州级治理受制度差异限制。
detailed_reading.conclusion: 本文提出三模型类型学，将州级运营治理与国际认证框架整合，为比较不同辖区的监管介入程度、治理复杂性和机构责任提供一致基础。该框架可作为交通机构和政策制定者的决策支持工具，用于权衡安全监督、行政负担、部署灵活性和组织能力。对北卡罗来纳而言，当前基线模式行政成本低但主动监督能力有限，未来需结合AV部署活动评估是否向行政自我认证或许可授权模式演进。
detailed_reading.key_details: 关键细节包括：分析聚焦SAE L4–5级完全自动驾驶车辆，州样本为目的性抽样且状态截至2026年1月；三级要求具有累积性，Tier 1为基础合规、注册和保险，Tier 2增加执法协调计划、平台自我认证和部署后报告，Tier 3增加部署前许可；三类模型对应轻、中、高监管工作量与机构能力需求。局限性在于主要依赖公开文件和定性比较，缺少监管效果的因果评估，国际框架对美国州级的直接可转移性有限，且部分州制度处于过渡或变化中，如哥伦比亚特区临时许可、得克萨斯2025年新许可要求、密歇根混合特征和怀俄明基本未监管。

quick_skim.title: Generative Reconstruction of Full-Field Sensor States for Safety-Critical Digital Twins
quick_skim.authors_text: Umme Mahbuba Nabila, Linyu Lin, Majdi I. Radaideh
quick_skim.abstract: Accurate reconstruction of incomplete sensor fields is critical for state awareness in safety-critical digital twins (DTs). Thermocouples in high-temperature and radiation environments may drift, fail, or become intermittently unavailable, causing partial observability. This study develops a sparse-sensor reconstruction framework for Oregon State University's High Temperature Test Facility (HTTF) and evaluates six methods under intra- and inter-experiment protocols: three conditional generative models (i.e., a diffusion model [DM], variational autoencoder [VAE], and generative adversarial network [GAN]), two deterministic recurrent neural-network models, and ridge regression. For intra-experiment reconstruction within the PG{-}29 depressurized conduction cooldown (DCC) test, the models combine graph-based spatial encoding with gated recurrent units. The graph neural network (GNN)--gated recurrent unit (GRU) VAE achieves the lowest error, with a mean absolute error (MAE) of $11.73,^\circ$C, a root mean square error (RMSE) of $20.54,^\circ$C, and an $R^2$ of 0.98. The deterministic GNN--GRU and plain GRU obtain RMSE values of $25.26,^\circ$C and $35.22,^\circ$C, respectively, demonstrating the benefit of spatial modeling. All three generative models reduce RMSE by more than half compared with ridge regression. The DM maintains an $R^2$ of 0.94 when known sensors decrease from 91 to 45. For inter-experiment reconstruction, models trained on PG{-}27 pressurized conduction cooldown (PCC) are evaluated on PG{-}29 using section-context conditioning. The section-context DM achieves the best transfer performance, with an RMSE of $42.84,^\circ$C and an $R^2$ of 0.91. These results demonstrate the value of spatiotemporal generative modeling for missing-sensor reconstruction in safety-critical DT applications.
quick_skim.tldr: This paper develops a sparse-sensor reconstruction framework for full-field sensor states in a safety-critical HTTF digital twin, showing that conditional spatiotemporal generative models—especially a GNN-GRU VAE for intra-experiment reconstruction and a section-context diffusion model for inter-experiment transfer—outperform deterministic and ridge-regression baselines.

quick_skim.title: Minimum-Sufficient Knowledge and Computation for Wind Energy Predictive Analysis
quick_skim.authors_text: Purbak Sengupta, Aparna S. varde, Emil Jørgensen Njor
quick_skim.abstract: Resource-constrained cyber-physical decision systems often apply fixed sensing, knowledge, and computational pipelines despite state-dependent information needs. We introduce Minimum-Sufficient Knowledge and Computation (MSKC), a resource-aware computing principle: select the least-costly route meeting decision-risk and deployment constraints, escalating only when cheaper routes are insufficient. As proof of concept, we isolate adaptive knowledge routing, the decision underlying Knowledge-Guided Machine Learning (KGML), which conventionally injects external knowledge unconditionally rather than only where needed. We instantiate this for wind ramp-event predictive analysis, an edge-oriented decision-support task, evaluating local, relational, and physics-informed routes with a state-aware gate on publicly available real data from two wind farms. We establish conditions for feasibility preservation, cost dominance, and strict expected savings over always-on routing. At a 35.9% relational-knowledge injection rate, adaptive routing is statistically indistinguishable from always-on injection on the reported metrics while reducing knowledge calls by 64%, supporting sustainable, Green-IT-aligned deployment. These results support MSKC's premise that uniformly maximal intelligence is unnecessary. This offers intelligent data analysis for big data streams: the analysis itself decides, per state, how much knowledge and computation the data warrant.
quick_skim.tldr: The paper introduces Minimum-Sufficient Knowledge and Computation (MSKC), showing that adaptively routing to the cheapest sufficient knowledge/computation path at each state can match always-on knowledge injection for wind ramp-event prediction while cutting knowledge calls by 64%.

quick_skim.title: Compressed Per-Player Local Methods for Multiplayer Federated Learning: Exact Convergence via Increment Sharing
quick_skim.authors_text: Bhavika Balani, TaeHo Yoon, Nicolas Loizou
quick_skim.abstract: Multiplayer Federated Learning (MpFL), introduced by Yoon et al. (2025), extends classical federated learning to settings where clients are rational players in a game with individual objectives and strategies, seeking an equilibrium. A natural baseline is Per-Player Local SGD (PEARL-SGD), where each player performs several local SGD steps before exchanging strategies through a central server. However, the original PEARL-SGD formulation does not extend cleanly to compressed communication. Directly compressing the players' strategies can prevent convergence to the equilibrium, even with deterministic gradients. To address this issue, we reformulate PEARL-SGD so that players communicate local strategy increments rather than the strategies themselves. Without compression, the two formulations are equivalent, but with compression, increment sharing preserves exact convergence, allowing us to design the communication-efficient compressed PEARL-SGD (C-PEARL-SGD). Beyond compression, we also consider variance reduction as another axis of improvement, introducing PEARL-SVRG and its compressed variant C-PEARL-SVRG. Under the original MpFL assumptions, we establish convergence guarantees for all variants through a unified parametric inequality. Numerical experiments, including distributed spectrum sensing, demonstrate the practical benefits of our methods over vanilla PEARL-SGD.
quick_skim.tldr: The paper reformulates PEARL-SGD for multiplayer federated learning to communicate local strategy increments rather than full strategies, enabling compressed communication with exact convergence and yielding new compressed and variance-reduced variants (C-PEARL-SGD, PEARL-SVRG, and C-PEARL-SVRG) with unified convergence guarantees.

quick_skim.title: Branch-Extended Automatic Differentiation
quick_skim.authors_text: Jan Hückelheim, Jeffrey Larson, Matt Menickelly
quick_skim.abstract: We present branch-extended automatic differentiation (BEAD), a software package that provides information about inactive branches of piecewise-differentiable functions, intended for use in nonsmooth optimization algorithms. BEAD is implemented in Python, building on the popular JAX framework. For supported nonsmooth operations such as abs and max, BEAD identifies alternative branches within tolerance from the given input, and computes gradients of the resulting branches extended to the given input. Such information has been previously used for robust optimization methods, but has required error-prone and tedious manual differentiation, unlike BEAD, which is fully automated for functions written in NumPy-like JAX code. Our experiments show that our approach is as accurate as manually written derivative code, and offers more flexibility in modifying the function and choosing between branch-discovery rules. While we were originally motivated by the manifold sampling algorithm for nonsmooth composite objectives, we also integrate BEAD branch-extension gradients into a nonsmooth BFGS-SQP solver. On two small nonsmooth test problems, the resulting path-aware search resolves failures or substantially reduces the number of evaluations required by the BFGS-SQP solver.
quick_skim.tldr: BEAD is a JAX-based Python package that automates branch-extended automatic differentiation by identifying inactive branches of piecewise-differentiable functions within tolerance and computing their extended gradients, enabling more robust nonsmooth optimization without manual derivative code.

quick_skim.title: Adaptive Depth Aggregation in Graph Transformers for Long-Range Graph Reasoning
quick_skim.abstract: Graph Transformers improve long-range node-to-node communication through global or structure-aware interactions. However, improving cross-node communication does not determine how computations produced at different depths should be combined. Standard residual streams accumulate successive computations with fixed unit coefficients shared across nodes. This fixed aggregation is a residual-interface constraint: once intermediate contributions have been produced, the interface cannot explicitly reweight them by node. We hypothesize that this constraint can create a depth-wise aggregation mismatch when the relative utility of these intermediate contributions varies across nodes and structural contexts. To study this hypothesis, we formalize Graph Transformer residual computation as a causal node-wise history of graph-propagation and feed-forward network (FFN) contributions, making depth aggregation an explicit interface choice. We realize node-adaptive aggregation over this history with Attention Residuals (AttnRes) while preserving the backbone's graph-propagation and auxiliary-state machinery. Block AttnRes reduces the routing cost of long histories relative to Full AttnRes by pooling consecutive contributions. We instantiate the interface in GPS and GRIT and evaluate it on all five ECHO tasks. Both variants achieve lower mean absolute error (MAE) than their independently tuned backbones on every task, and at least one obtains the lowest mean among all compared methods in each task. Routing-only donor-swap interventions support the mismatch hypothesis, while additional ablations examine the key design choices. Together, these results support node-adaptive depth aggregation as a useful complement to cross-node communication in long-range graph reasoning.
quick_skim.tldr: The paper proposes **AttnRes-GT**, a node-adaptive depth aggregation mechanism using Attention Residuals that lets each node reweight graph-propagation and FFN contributions across layers, improving long-range graph reasoning in Graph Transformers such as GPS and GRIT.

quick_skim.title: Higher Order Component Attribution via Learned Surrogates in High Energy Physics
quick_skim.authors_text: Lauri Laatu, Aritra Bal, Benedikt Maier, Markus Klute, Michael Spannowsky
quick_skim.abstract: Experimental High Energy Physics (HEP) has adopted the transformer architecture for identification of jets, particularly the state-of-the-art Particle Transformer (ParT) which injects explicit information about particle correlations into the attention mechanism. While able to achieve state-of-the-art results in accuracy, interpretability to its effectiveness has been limited. In this paper we propose component attribution methods using Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) that directly tie back to the physical descriptors of jets, to probe whether mechanisms such as Multi-Head Attention (MHA), or the ParT architecture, are able to learn these as discriminating features.
quick_skim.tldr: This paper proposes higher-order component attribution using Kolmogorov-Arnold Network surrogates to test whether transformer-based jet taggers such as Particle Transformer learn the same physical multi-particle jet substructure correlations captured by energy correlation functions.

quick_skim.title: Rethinking Data Selection as Distribution Matching on Semantic Manifolds
quick_skim.authors_text: Peng Sun, Yi Yang, Mingshuo Chen, Chunxiao Li, Yao Zhu, Huawen Shen, Tianfan Fu
quick_skim.abstract: Instruction tuning of large language models and large vision language models relies on massive training data, which incurs substantial computational and storage costs. Meanwhile, training data often contains redundancy, noise, and low quality samples. Existing data selection methods mostly rely on diversity, importance, or a combination of both, without explicitly constraining the distributional consistency between the selected subset and the full data in the embedding space. We propose QMAC, a quality aware multiband characteristic function matching method that formulates data selection as a joint optimization problem of distribution matching and quality filtering. QMAC matches the empirical characteristic functions of the selected subset and the full data across multiple frequency scales, capturing both global semantic coverage and local perturbations, while using task related quality scores to filter noisy and low quality samples. We systematically evaluate QMAC on 4 data types, 8 target models, and 44 benchmarks. Experimental results show that QMAC outperforms existing data selection baselines on standard image-text instruction data, substantially surpasses random selection on standard text instruction, image-text reasoning, and text reasoning data, and exceeds full data training in multiple model and budget combinations. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance of the paper.
quick_skim.tldr: QMAC is a quality-aware data selection method that selects a high-quality subset by matching its empirical characteristic function to the full dataset across multiple frequency scales, thereby preserving semantic-manifold distributional coverage while filtering noisy or low-quality samples.

quick_skim.title: How Small Can We Go? Calibrating Activation-Cache Compression for SAE Training
quick_skim.abstract: To train a sparse autoencoder (SAE), you need a massive cache of model activations. We look into the effects that compression has on an SAE in two ways: we keep the original fp32-trained SAE and pass the compressed cache into the same SAE to see how many feature activations stay the same (the frozen-SAE test), and we retrain an SAE on the compressed cache and see how many of the original features still exist (the retraining test). We found that in the retraining test, there is no clear scale for retained features. On a GPT-2 cache, rounding everything to fp16 keeps 60.6% of features, but changing one value in a million by the smallest step fp32 allows (a change eight orders of magnitude smaller) keeps only 70.5%. Meanwhile, changing the random seed keeps 23.0%. For the frozen-SAE test, the frozen SAE's correlation with the original increases in order of how precise the codecs are, but plain $L_2$ distance gives nearly the same ordering. We also see the same frozen reading correspond to different percentages retained at different sites. This leaves the question of the right measurement. We build one by calibrating: retraining on identical bytes sets the ceiling, and a reseed sets the floor. We then measure the effect of each compressed codec against its own site's floor. With TopK SAEs on GPT-2 small and Pythia-1.4B at research-scale budgets, naïve per-token int4 loses more features than a reseed everywhere we tested, as do PCA and random projection on GPT-2. Standardizing each channel before quantizing brings int4 back above the floor in terms of retained features, at the same raw file size. At our smallest budget, a bf16 forward pass, which some pipelines use to save memory, loses slightly more features than rotated 8-bit storage. Calibrating a site costs four training runs and two evaluation passes.
quick_skim.tldr: The paper shows that activation-cache compression for SAE training should be evaluated against calibrated same-process controls—identical-byte retraining as the ceiling and reseeding as the floor—because absolute feature-retention percentages are unstable while codec rankings are reliable, and it finds that per-channel standardization can make int4 viable whereas a bf16 forward pass can lose more features than rotated int8 storage.

quick_skim.title: Evolutionary Adaptive Metric Learning: A Multi-Objective Framework for Learning Local Distance Functions in Nearest Neighbor Classification
quick_skim.abstract: Nearest neighbour classifiers inherit the geometry of their distance function. Fixed distances and globally learned metrics apply the same geometry throughout the input space, although relevant feature directions may vary across regions. We propose EAML (Evolutionary Adaptive Metric Learning), a framework that learns instance-dependent positive-definite metrics through a low-dimensional parameterization. Each local metric combines an input-dependent diagonal scaling, generated by softmax interpolation between anchor points, with a global low-rank correlation component. A real-coded elitist genetic algorithm optimizes the parameters using a scalar objective combining leave-one-out prediction error, robustness, metric smoothness, and regularization. We establish positive definiteness, metric equivalence, existence of an optimal solution, and Lipschitz continuity of the metric field. We further investigate prediction stability, generalization bounds, and evolutionary convergence under explicit assumptions. Experiments on synthetic data with region-dependent feature relevance show that EAML can recover local metric variations and outperform global metrics. Evaluation on thirteen public datasets using nested 5-fold cross-validation reveals a more nuanced picture: EAML improves performance on selected datasets but does not significantly outperform global metric baselines overall. Additional experiments show that global diagonal metrics can be preferable under nuisance features and test-time noise. These findings identify the conditions under which evolutionary local metric learning is beneficial and highlight its practical limitations.
quick_skim.tldr: EAML learns smooth, instance-dependent positive-definite distance metrics through a low-dimensional softmax-anchored local scaling plus global low-rank component, optimized by an elitist genetic algorithm over classification, robustness, smoothness, and regularization objectives—but experiments show it mainly helps when feature relevance varies locally and does not consistently outperform well-tuned global metrics.

quick_skim.title: FasterRW: An Efficient Prior-Assisted Random Walk Solver for Thermal Analysis
quick_skim.authors_text: Zixiao Wang, Tianshu Hou, Chenghan Wang, Zhen Zhuang, Leilei Jin, Tsung-Yi Ho, Farzan Farnia, Bei Yu
quick_skim.abstract: Thermal simulation is becoming increasingly critical in modern IC design and manufacturing. Feynman--Kac random walk methods can estimate localized temperatures without solving the global field, but in practical settings without Dirichlet boundaries they require very long paths to control the truncation residual. This paper presents FasterRW, a continuation-value framework for accelerating Feynman--Kac thermal random walks. We prove a stopping-time residual identity showing that the expected tail after truncation equals the current attenuation weight multiplied by the temperature at the stopping location. This identity enables a prior-corrected single-point estimator: a cheap, noisy prior replaces the unknown continuation value, making the truncation bias scale with prior error rather than absolute temperature and yielding an error-controlled threshold-selection rule. For multi-point queries, FasterRW further converts cross-query pass-through tails into pseudo-samples and refines the resulting observations in prior-error coordinates through kriging. Compared with prior state-of-the-art methods, FasterRW achieves up to $28\times$ acceleration while maintaining accuracy. Our code is open-sourced at https://github.com/ShiningSord/FastRW.
quick_skim.tldr: FasterRW accelerates Feynman–Kac thermal random-walk simulation by using a stopping-time residual identity and a cheap prior-corrected estimator—plus kriging for multi-point queries—to achieve up to 28× speedup while maintaining accuracy.

quick_skim.title: EMT Modeling and Coordinated Mode-Transition Ride-Through Control of Modern Data Centers
quick_skim.authors_text: Junyuan Zheng, Salish Maharjan, Min Lwin, Soummya Roy, Zhaoyu Wang, Wenlong Shi, Feng Qiu, Rajarshi Roychowdhury
quick_skim.abstract: Large data centers are emerging as power-electronic loads whose response to grid voltage disturbances can affect bulk-system stability. This paper presents the composition and control characteristics of a proprietary electromagnetic transient (EMT) model of a modern data center comprising an uninterruptible power supply (UPS) with battery energy storage, induction-motor cooling loads, a computer room air handler (CRAH) driven by a variable-frequency drive (VFD), and an aggregated server load. A voltage-based state machine coordinates three aspects of the facility response: the UPS operating mode (eco, double conversion, or battery), the supply path of the CRAH, and a ramped reconnection of the grid-side UPS converter after the disturbance clears. A 100 MW facility is implemented in PSCAD/EMTDC and benchmarked against the PSSE PERC1 aggregate data center model under a symmetrical three-phase fault and low- and high-voltage ride-through (LVRT/HVRT) events. The two models agree closely in their voltage and active-power trajectories, while the EMT model also resolves the converter and motor-reacceleration transients that the phasor-domain model cannot.
quick_skim.tldr: The paper presents a PSCAD/EMTDC electromagnetic-transient model of a modern data center—including UPS/BESS, induction-motor cooling loads, a VFD-driven CRAH, and aggregated server load—with a voltage-based state machine that coordinates UPS mode transitions, CRAH supply path, and ramped post-fault reconnection, and benchmarks its fault/LVRT/HVRT ride-through behavior against PSS/E aggregate models, showing close aggregate agreement while capturing converter and motor-reacceleration transients.
quick_skim.affiliations_text: INS Engineering, Iowa State University, Argonne National Laboratory, Xcel Energy

quick_skim.title: Multi-objective Electric Vehicle Charging Strategies at Energy Hubs with Justice-informed Profit Distribution among Users
quick_skim.authors_text: Twan Stolwijk, Diego Fernandez-Zapico, Alessandro Piazza, Mauro Salazar
quick_skim.abstract: This paper studies potential energy cost savings in electric vehicle (EV) charging hubs when users allow cooperative vehicle-to-grid (V2G), and how such savings should be redistributed. To this end, we present multi-objective operational strategies and justice-informed profit sharing methods for a charging energy hub equipped with a battery storage system and solar panels. Specifically, we first frame the dynamic energy hub operational problem aiming to minimize a combination of grid costs and emissions, accounting for time-varying prices and energy mix as well as storage system and EV battery degradation, which is especially relevant when considering V2G operations. We parse the problem as a second-order conic program that can be efficiently solved to global optimality. Our real-world case-study shows the importance of flexibility for hub operation: Equipping a charging station with a stationary battery and leveraging dynamic V2G can significantly reduce the total costs and emissions compared to conventional settings without a battery or dynamic charging by more than 10%. To redistribute these cost benefits to users, we compare standard Nash bargaining with a justice-informed sufficientarian version which caps charging prices to safeguard adequate access to affordable charging. Our results show that the sufficientarian approach better accounts for inequalities in flexibility capital without significantly affecting aggregate costs, highlighting how justice-informed pricing only marginally affects total revenues.
quick_skim.tldr: This paper develops multi-objective optimal charging strategies for a solar- and battery-equipped EV hub using V2G to cut costs and emissions by over 10%, and compares Nash bargaining with a justice-informed sufficientarian profit-sharing scheme that caps charging prices to address unequal flexibility without significantly reducing total revenues.

quick_skim.title: What Are LLM Agents Actually Learning on Low-Budget Molecular Optimization Benchmarks?
quick_skim.authors_text: Jiayu Qin, Zhengquan Luo, Changyou Chen, Zhiqiang Xu
quick_skim.abstract: Recent work reports large gains for LLM agents on low-budget molecular optimization. We measure the contributions of online optimization, retrievable task information, and permissive oracle landscapes. On PMO at 50 oracle calls, a GPT-4o mini agent's sum AUC falls from 14.44 to 4.85 after task names and curated reference compounds are hidden. An identity-blinded condition that states only the oracle form (e.g., similarity to a hidden reference) scores 5.39, while a deterministic retrieval-only baseline with no LLM reaches 12.16 (84% of the full agent). A full 23-task 2x2 ablation and a three-seed replication on eight tasks support this interpretation. On a protein-targeted benchmark with an AutoDock Vina composite oracle, a single-edit random walk is a strong lower bound; across three seeds it obtains composite 0.636 +/- 0.008 and docking improvement -1.11 +/- 0.04 kcal/mol. As a positive control, a retrieval-free population agent exceeds REINVENT at a matched 50-call AUC budget, with its strongest result at 100 calls. These results motivate two inexpensive sanity checks: retrieval-safe PMO prompts and a random-walk floor for docking-based optimization.
quick_skim.tldr: The paper shows that reported LLM-agent gains on low-budget molecular-optimization benchmarks are largely explained by retrievable task/reference information and permissive oracle landscapes rather than genuine online optimization, and it recommends retrieval-safe prompts and random-walk baselines as inexpensive sanity checks.

quick_skim.title: Not All Misalignment Is Alike: A Decomposed Benchmark for Emergent Misalignment
quick_skim.authors_text: Afonso Domingues, Mubashara Akhtar, Bhada Yun, Xin Chen, Lukas Fluri, Anna Hedström
quick_skim.abstract: Emergent misalignment (EM), in which fine-tuning on a narrow task induces misaligned behaviour on unrelated prompts, has been demonstrated across a wide range of datasets, model families, and training setups. Yet, most studies continue to rely on the evaluation approach introduced in the original EM paper, producing rates that are sensitive to the small set of evaluation questions used, the choice of judge, and the thresholds applied. These evaluations can also conflate misalignment with capability loss and offer little insight into the specific ways misalignment manifests. Differences in datasets, models, and fine-tuning configurations further make findings difficult to compare across studies. We introduce EMERGE, a decomposed benchmark that tracks changes in eight distinct misaligned behaviours from base to fine-tuned models. It evaluates these behaviours on out-of-domain prompts against matched benign controls and tracks capability, coherence, and refusal to account for potential confounders. Applying EMERGE to 8 open-weight models and 13 fine-tuning datasets, we find that models with similar broad misalignment rates can exhibit very different behavioural profiles that a single score cannot capture. We hope EMERGE can help establish a shared and robust standard for measuring EM, making findings more comparable and helping move research from detecting the phenomenon towards understanding it.
quick_skim.tldr: The paper introduces **EMERGE**, a decomposed benchmark that tracks eight distinct emergent-misalignment behaviors—while controlling for capability, coherence, and refusal—across 8 open-weight models and 13 fine-tuning datasets, showing that similar aggregate misalignment rates can mask very different behavioral profiles and aiming to provide a robust, comparable standard for studying emergent misalignment.

quick_skim.title: Does Country Matter? Evaluating Geographic Sensitivity of Large Language Models in Zero-Shot Chronic Kidney Disease Screening
quick_skim.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) show strong zero-shot reasoning capabilities, yet their sensitivity to prompt context raises questions about reliability in deployment. This study investigates whether geographic context embedded in prompts influences LLM-based chronic kidney disease (CKD) screening, independent of any change in patient features. Using a community-based CKD dataset from Bangladesh (284 participants with 112 CKD and 172 non-CKD), we systematically varied the country attribute across 25 global contexts while holding all clinical inputs constant, and evaluated two open-weight LLMs (Qwen3 8B and Mistral 7B). Experiments were conducted on a common-correct subset of 156 participants for whom both models produced correct baseline predictions. Results show that non-CKD predictions were highly stable across geographic contexts, with both models maintaining consistent non-CKD predictions in nearly all settings. In contrast, CKD-positive predictions were considerably more sensitive. For Qwen3, CKD prediction dropped from a baseline of 65 to as low as 50 across country contexts, while Mistral showed smaller but non-negligible variation. Country contexts did not group according to known epidemiological or healthcare similarities; instead, groupings appear to reflect how country tokens are internally represented within each model. These findings demonstrate that geographic tokens can systematically shift clinical screening outcomes despite identical patient inputs, with implications for the deployment of LLM-based decision support in diverse healthcare settings.
quick_skim.tldr: Varying only the country context in prompts—while holding patient features constant—systematically shifts LLM zero-shot chronic kidney disease screening predictions, especially CKD-positive cases, revealing geographic sensitivity that threatens reliable clinical deployment.
